description: The ``AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Model`` resource updates data model for a WebSocket API. For more information, see [Model Selection Expressions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-websocket-api-selection-expressions.html#apigateway-websocket-api-model-selection-expressions) in the *API Gateway Developer Guide*.. Source:- https://github.com/aws-cloudformation/aws-cloudformation-resource-providers-apigatewayv2

ContentType.description: The content-type for the model, for example, "application/json".

Schema.description: The schema for the model. For application/json models, this should be JSON schema draft 4 model.
